overview_description.description: Midrender provides an AI-powered visual editor and motion graphics framework for software teams and developers. The platform connects to a codebase, analyzes components, layouts, and styles, and uses this context to generate animated product feature walkthroughs and launch videos. Its visual editor offers a timeline, keyframes, properties, and layout tools for refining scenes created by the AI assistant. Midrender is built on Revideo, an open-source TypeScript framework for programmatic video creation that supports headless rendering, audio, and server-driven workflows. The product integrates with Model Context Protocol, enabling agents in tools like AI code editors to trigger motion content generation from the terminal. Midrender serves application developers and product teams who need programmatic and AI-assisted video automation embedded into their development workflows.
